ALLIED CONFERENCE BEGUN.

The conference of the Premiers of Great Britain and France with Count Sferza the representative of the Italian Premier, opened yesterday Jan 24th at the Quai d'Orsay. The subjects for discussion are primarily German disarmament and German reparation. The disarmament problem was considered yesterday, and favourable progress is reported.
